name: F1 Tracker
tagline: A Formula 1 season on a 480×480 touchscreen.
description: A Formula 1 season on a 480x480 touchscreen: the grid, the circuits, the drivers. Made for ESPHome.

hero.alt: The race page: circuit map, state line and top five

features.title: On a race weekend
features.text: the circuit map for the track, the drivers in starting order, a flag for each driver and for the course.

features.title: Otherwise
features.text: a carousel of every circuit with its facts, every current driver, and the legends, with portraits.

features.title: Watches one driver
features.text: and tells you when they are racing, where they start, and how they finished.

features.title: Championship tables
features.text: permutations, a post-race summary, and a birthday card when it is one.
